inputs.concrete_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: declared 25 MPa cylinder compressive strength. No site testing or manufacturer evidence supplied.
inputs.steel_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: declared yield stress 500 MPa, elastic-perfectly plastic idealization. Not a measured steel grade.
inputs.steel_E_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: declared Es=200000 MPa for the numerical benchmark; no actual coupon evidence.
inputs.cover_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: declared bottom/side and end clear cover 75 mm. Geometric input only, no durability/detailing compliance.
inputs.bar_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: declared straight round 20 mm bars, no hooks, development or anchorage resistance assumed.
inputs.effective_depth_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: d=450-75-20/2=365 mm, measured from compression face to bottom bar centroid.
inputs.arrangement_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: eight straight East-West bars evenly spaced across the full 1200 mm width, outer centres cover+radius from sides; one layer only.
inputs.strain_model_source: Archived FHWA-HRT-05-056 ch3a: https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/publications/research/infrastructure/bridge/05056/chapt3a.cfm . Synthetic block alpha=beta=0.85, ecu=0.003; plane sections, ignore concrete tension; declared maximum steel strain 0.05 is a benchmark domain limit, not a certified ductility property.
inputs.design_action_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: independently declared 250 kN m nominal-equilibrium target only, NOT derived or factored from the saved 12.15 kN m unfactored cut demand. No code design-strength factor applied.
inputs.load_path_source: SYNTHETIC VERIFICATION: reviewed hypothetical direct centered column patch solely for the saved demand benchmark. Actual steel-to-concrete transfer remains unverified and project safety blocked.

formula: Plane sections: eps_s=eps_cu*(d-c)/c. C=alpha*fc*b*beta*c; T=As*min(Es*eps_s,fy). Supported yielded case: a=As*fy/(alpha*fc*b), c=a/beta, Mn=As*fy*(d-a/2). As_target solves Mn=M_declared ONLY as nominal-equilibrium comparison. No phi or material factors.
reference_note: Archived FHWA-HRT-05-056, discussion of rectangular stress blocks and strain compatibility. Declared benchmark block/strain values only; no ACI/IS factors or compliance inferred.
limitations: Synthetic cylinder strength and ideal elastic-perfectly-plastic steel only, no actual material evidence
One straight bottom reinforcement layer along East-West; no orthogonal mat, compression steel, prestress or axial section force
20<=fc<=28 MPa, 250<=fy<=600 MPa, declared steel strain <=0.05; reject non-yielding or excessive-strain states
Steel area for target is nominal-equilibrium mathematics, not code-required design steel
Declared action is independently sourced and is not a factored version of saved unfactored footing demand
No minimum steel, spacing/detailing, development, anchorage, cracking, one-way shear, punching or footing approval
Selecting country/standard/edition records context only; no automatic strength definitions, stress blocks or factors change
